claim_one_line: ONE POLYNOMIAL, THREE FACES -- the saddle, the founding obstruction, and the boundary structure are the SAME Phi3 = u^2+u+1, and the map between them is c. THE CROSS-SEAT EVENT: cloud independently reproduced two of this bench's batch-5 results (the kappa-law governing the relational bit, B1195/GC-24; and its SELECTOR-FREEDOM, B1196/GC-27 -- epsilon constant on the pair's orbit) and returned a cross-link this bench did not name, Phi3(kappa-2) = 0, VERIFIED HERE EXACTLY rather than adopted. FACE 1, the saddle: B1195/GC-21 derived u^2+u+1 = 0 from the stationary phase of the object's own b=1 partition function, knowing nothing of kappa. FACE 2, the founding obstruction: kappa = tr[a,b] = u^2+2 at the Eisenstein point with |kappa-2| = 1 (the unit obstruction -- existence as frustrated cancellation, B309/B518/B285), whence kappa-2 = u^2 and Phi3(kappa-2) = 0 IDENTICALLY MOD Phi3 (exact polynomial remainder -- an identity of the construction, not a numerical coincidence). FACE 3, the boundary: cloud's memo-104 object (E6 as a free rank-3 Z[omega]-module) has Coxeter^4 giving M^2+M+I = 0, the same Phi3, rebuilt here with M^3 = I. THE SET IDENTITY: the saddle set IS {kappa-2, its conjugate} -- the same two numbers, not merely roots of the same polynomial. THE LINKING MAP, this bench's addition: the map carrying a saddle point to the obstruction is u -> u^2, which on the two primitive cube roots is exactly the SWAP -- the Galois generator c (B1174: c = mirror = chirality = Gal(K/Q)'s generator) -- so the faces are not merely governed by one polynomial, THE MAP BETWEEN THEM IS THE PROGRAM'S ONE INVOLUTION. WHAT THIS UNIFIES: the existence audit's list treated item 1 (SEAM-A's saddle) and item 4 (the bit's kappa-law) as separate; they are ONE INVARIANT -- the polynomial whose vanishing IS the founding frustration is the polynomial whose roots are where the partition function is stationary, and the boundary satisfies it too. THE OTHER HARVEST, GRADED: cloud's quine build (memo 107) landed on OUTCOME Q1 -- 'the self-report is complete except exactly one bit, and the bit is c' -- EXACTLY what B1184 predicted when the spec's criterion was anchored to it, with Q2 not firing so B1183 stands; their external-bit count and this bench's relational bit are (their words) 'the same statement at two levels' -- CITED, their certificate not re-run here, verification queued. Cloud's other new work and codex's R020/R021/R022 are fetched and QUEUED for digestion, unharvested, per the owner's 'when time'. FENCES: the identity is this bench's own symbolic re-derivation (cloud's memo is the prompt, not the evidence); FACE 3 is rebuilt only as the abstract Phi3-companion relation, their E6/Z[omega] construction remaining CITED/UNVERIFIED here; nothing weakens a negative -- kappa != 2 is still the obstruction, the marking is still not derived; the result is that these were never three facts.
